headline: Carrier (CARR) Appoints Neil Barua To Board As Tech Focus Comes Into View
summary: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) has appointed technology executive Neil Barua as an independent director. Barua will serve on the Compensation Committee and the Technology & Innovation Committee. The appointment adds experience from his leadership roles at PTC Inc. and ServiceMax to Carrier Global's board. Carrier Global comes into this board change with its shares at $59.92 and a mixed recent track record. The stock is up 12.0% year to date, while it has declined 18.4% over the past 30 days and...
